author: piztanza
description: Landing refinements (F-001): AI catalog card moved between the buyer strip and Why Mobeeli with symmetric section padding; nav anchors always scroll programmatically (re-click works after scrolling away) and center short sections like #why-now in the viewport (tall sections top-align below the nav); IntersectionObserver scrollspy silently tracks the active section (replaceState hash + aria-current/data-active + context state, no visible styling yet).
acceptance_criteria: Landing band order is hero → proof → problem → how-it-works → buyer strip → AI catalog → why-mobeeli → unify → footer, with the AI catalog band padded 96px top and bottom
Clicking 'Why Mobeeli' centers the section vertically when it is shorter than the viewport; taller targets align top with the 84px nav offset; reduced motion jumps instantly

Re-clicking the SAME nav item after scrolling away always scrolls back — verified without visiting another section/page first; works from desktop nav and the hamburger menu, and via /#id from other pages

As the user scrolls, the active section is tracked: URL hash updates via replaceState without scroll jumps or history entries, and the matching nav link carries aria-current/data-active; no visual nav change
Scrollspy suspends during programmatic scrolls (no hash flicker)
Suite green with updated order test + scroll math + scrollspy tests
